name: コミュニティ内の内容切替
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. ONE Lighthouse component LH03-0022「コミュニティ内の内容切替」. Image1 ORIGINAL controls segmented-control geometry, selected-left state, proportions and fine details. Image2 Japanese mock secondary for exact content/locked typography; Image3 approved white/forestgreen style only.
Render one compact horizontal two-segment switch, logical390x52. Outer track at16,8 width358 height36, white#FFFFFF with fine neutral outline,12px corners. Left selected inset pill at19,11 width174 height30 with smooth forestgreen gradient135deg #174C36→#1F6444→#2D8F5E, gentle edge light and restrained shadow; exact label「コミュニティ」white, Meiryo Bold12px/16px tracking0 centered. Right UNSELECTED segment exact「お知らせ」Meiryo Regular12px/16px tracking0 centered, quiet slate#526173 on white. Preserve source leftselected/rightunselected state and weight distinction. No icons, underline, badges, title, extra segments, controls, surrounding screen, or phone.
Accent evidence: original uses white selected pill on gray track, mock same. Adapt meaningful selected state to official forestgreen primaryselected pill; unselected track stays white, no broadmint/tinted backgrounds. Selection remains visible by inset filled pill and bold label, not merely hue. Keep original proportions, complete Japanese wording and same uniform relative scale. Purewhite canvas, one complete narrowwide component centered prominently with modest margins, no clipping. Static raster candidate.
reviewNotes: 出力を目視。日本語2項目・左選択・白外面・形は保持したが、お知らせの非選択ラベルが指定Regularより太く見える。選択の緑上端も指定森林緑より鮮やか。厳密な字体/色計測は未実施。未修正候補として保存し、非選択の通常ウエイトと抑制した森林緑へ限定修正する。所有者承認・編集可能性・実切替は未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
